push_to_hub_metric: push computed metric results to a model repository metadata on Hugging Face Hub
push_to_hub_with_config: push a metric result with dataset config, split, and revision to a Hugging Face model card
push_to_hub_overwrite: overwrite existing metric metadata on a Hugging Face Hub model repository
push_to_hub_validate_task: validate task type against allowed Hub tasks before pushing metric to model card
push_to_hub_verify_model: verify a model exists on Hugging Face Hub before updating its metadata
